receipts.first_text_witness: Have you ever felt your heart race when opening a credit card statement? Maybe you've avoided checking your bank account for weeks because the anxiety feels overwhelming. Or perhaps you find yourself making completely irrational financial decisions that you can't explain even to yourself. If any of this sounds familiar, you're definitely not alone and more importantly, you're not broken.
receipts.last_text_witness: someone who has choices, even when those choices are difficult. And honestly, that shift from helplessness to agency might be worth more than any investment return you'll ever see. Uh if this video helped you understand why you do what you do with money, hit that like button, and let me know in the comments what money script you recognize in yourself, because I guarantee you're not the only one.
